# Remote Work Policy (Test Material)

(This is a self-made evaluation corpus document; all content is fictional.)

Section 1. Employees may apply for up to two remote-work days per week with manager approval.

Section 2. Remote employees must be reachable online from 10:00 to 16:00 on working days.

Section 3. The company provides a remote-work allowance of 300 yuan per month for network costs.

Section 4. Confidential documents must not be printed or stored on personal devices while working remotely.

Section 5. Remote work agreements are reviewed every six months by the human resources department.
